title: Plus Size Gathered Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size chiffon maxi dress beautifully shows off the shoulders and collarbone with its off the shoulder neckline. The fitted waist gives gentle shape, while the flowing skirt moves with ease. A lovely choice for weddings, bridal parties, and other formal occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side left zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
